products.title: Radius Corner Channel Fixed - Reeded Glass
products.body_html:
Radius Corner Shower Screens

Create a sleek, contemporary bathroom with Stegbar’s Radius Corner Shower Screens. Designed to maximise space while delivering a soft, elegant aesthetic, these shower screens feature distinctive curved corners that bring a modern touch to any bathroom renovation or new build.

With reeded glass on the outside, and smooth glass on the inside, these shower screens offer on-trend aesthetic with practical functionality.

Combining style with everyday practicality, Radius Corner Shower Screens provide a spacious showering area while helping to create a seamless, open feel within your bathroom. Manufactured from premium materials and built to Stegbar’s high standards of quality, they offer durability, functionality, and timeless appeal.

Features & Benefits

  • Contemporary curved design for a softer, more sophisticated bathroom look.
  • Space-maximising configuration ideal for a wide range of bathroom layouts.
  • Toughened safety glass for strength, durability, and peace of mind.
  • Smooth-operating doors designed for everyday convenience.
  • Easy-clean surfaces help reduce maintenance and keep your shower looking its best.
  • Multiple size options to suit different bathroom requirements.
  • Australian-made quality backed by Stegbar’s reputation for craftsmanship.
